text: RESULTS: Spirometry shows FEV1 at 65% predicted, FVC at 80% predicted, and a decreased FEV1/FVC ratio. Bronchodilator reversibility results are not included in the provided data. Based on your respiratory examination, bilateral wheezing is more pronounced on expiration. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma with occupational exacerbation due to construction dust exposure. The combination of a history of childhood asthma, positive skin testing for dust mites and pollen, reduced FEV1/FVC ratio, and clear improvement with bronchodilators confirms this diagnosis. I recommend immediate avoidance of construction dust, starting a high-dose inhaled corticosteroid regimen, and scheduling a follow-up in two weeks to monitor lung function.
